name: Bundelkhand Expressway

timeline.event: Foundation stone laid by the Prime Minister in February
Opened to traffic on 16 July, ahead of schedule

history: The Bundelkhand Expressway gives the dry, less-developed Bundelkhand region its first fast road link toward Agra and Delhi. Prime Minister Narendra Modi laid the foundation stone in February 2020 and opened the finished road in July 2022, months ahead of schedule. It runs 296 km from the Agra–Lucknow Expressway near Etawah to Gonda village near Chitrakoot, crossing seven districts.
facts: Completed in about 28 months, ahead of its target date.
Joins the Agra–Lucknow Expressway near Etawah, giving Bundelkhand a continuous expressway run toward Agra and Delhi.
Passes through seven districts: Etawah, Auraiya, Jalaun, Hamirpur, Mahoba, Banda and Chitrakoot.
Crosses major Bundelkhand rivers including the Yamuna, Betwa and Ken.
